summary: Round 2 features (driver application + admin approval, image object storage w/ token-auth serving, ratings, driver earnings, GCash manual payment, complaints, ban) validated end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 new-feature pytest cases pass + 26/26 regression cases from iteration_1 still pass (41/41 total). Frontend: verified admin login → Admin Overview shows the two new cards ('Driver Applications' with pending count + 'Complaints' with open count and red dot indicator), tapping each navigates to /admin/applications and /admin/complaints which render pending list w/ document thumbnails and complaint list w/ category badge + Suspend Driver / Reviewed actions. Driver phone-login (Mang Tonyo) → new Earnings tab renders TODAY / This Week / All Time / rating (5.0 based on 1 customer rating) values pulled from GET /api/driver/earnings correctly. Image upload flow validated via backend endpoint (POST /api/upload returns storage path, GET /api/files/{path}?token= returns bytes for owner + admin, 401 without token, 403 for other users). GCash flow (booking payment_method='gcash' → customer submits gcash_ref → payment_status=submitted → driver confirms → confirmed) works and non-driver/non-admin gets 403 on confirm. Ratings flow: 200 on first rate, 409 on duplicate, driver rating_avg/rating_count updated. Complaint flow: invalid category → 422, valid → 200, admin list + resolve works, banned driver cannot go online (403). Regression: existing auth, ride booking, pabili flows all intact.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Cosmetic on web preview; migrate to boxShadow for future-proofing.
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic; move any JSX pointerEvents prop into style.

action_items: (Optional polish) Migrate SHADOW.card and other shadow* usages in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.

Test data note (non-blocking): pytest applications contain fake doc paths ('a','b','c') so their thumbnails render broken icons on /admin/applications. This is only test-data pollution — real uploads (via POST /api/upload) return valid storage paths and render fine in AuthImage. Optionally seed cleanup of TEST_ users if you want a pristine admin screen for demos.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grown to 908 lines (up from 570) — still readable but reaching the split threshold; consider extracting drivers/apps, ratings, payments, complaints into routers if adding more features.
GET /api/files/{path} correctly enforces token auth and owner/admin scope (line 573-587). Good.
public_user() correctly exposes driver_status, banned, rating_avg, rating_count without leaking password/_id.
driver_status endpoint (line 481) checks banned + approved before allowing online — matches product spec (pending/rejected/banned all blocked).
compute of driver earnings correctly separates ride 'fare' vs order 'service_fee' (line 626) so item cost is not counted as driver revenue.
Rating dedup enforced via job.rated flag + 409 (line 658-659). Good.
seed() migration marks pre-existing drivers as 'approved' so they don't get blocked after this feature rollout (line 880-883). Good backwards-compat.
Object storage lazy-init w/ retry on 503 for expired storage_key (line 121-130). Good.
